title: fix: persist monitor protocol state
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds protocolFlagged to the final state-write checklist
- Keeps the new two-cycle stream-error streak explicit across agent cycles

Follow-up to #14302

gist.headline: The monitor remembers
gist.blurb: The community monitor now carries its protocol flag cleanly between cycles. Even little checklist bees deserve persistent memory.
gist.summary: Updated the community-monitor cycle checklist so protocolFlagged is written into final state and a two-cycle stream-error streak remains explicit across agent cycles.
gist.impact: Community monitoring agents now retain their protocol and stream-error context between runs, making follow-up behavior more consistent.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed monitoring station where Polli records a small protocol flag and a two-day error streak in a persistent logbook beside a CRT terminal. The scene represents state surviving from one monitoring cycle to the next, with sprouts growing from labeled checklist pages.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot wearing a tiny librarian scarf, carefully writing a protocol flag into a glowing logbook beside a retro CRT monitoring terminal; two small calendar tiles show an explicit two-cycle stream-error streak, while code-plants sprout from the checklist pages. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle scanlines, emotionally warm.
